title: CommonTensorComparisonDescent
statement: Use the canonical representative maps [def-sf-common-tensor-comparison-representatives]. For a rational tensor comparison system [def-sf-rational-tensor-comparison-system], take the literal source pair quotient [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] and target [def-weil-point-fd-qlbar-category]. Common-stage tensor descent data record their symmetric monoidal structures, with source tensor represented at the compositum and unit at the base field; stage tensorators and canonical common-stage isomorphisms; and a functor $G$ with object formula $(E,X)\mapsto(E,F_EX)$ and arrow formula $[f]_L\mapsto[\phi_{L/E'}F_L(f)\phi_{L/E}^{-1}]_L$. Its tensor comparison at every common field $L$ is represented by $\tau_L$ followed by $\phi_{L/E}\otimes\phi_{L/E'}$ and the balanced target tensor identification. The validity predicate gives the quotient-class formulas for source tensor and unit transport, the tensor of quotient morphisms, the canonical target tensor and unit under faithful realization, signed symmetry, and the unit formula at every base field. For $K\subset L$, the source transport $d_{L,K}$ is the transition tensorator followed by both tower comparisons; the required equation is $\gamma_L F_L(d_{L,K})\phi_{L/K}^{-1}=e_{L,K}B_{L/K}(\gamma_K)$, with $e$ the normalized balanced scalar tensorator and field tower comparisons. This specifies independence of representatives and of common fields, including identity inclusions and incomparable fields through a further compositum. This record asserts no existence.
